message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, red, serif letters at the top. Below this, an illustration depicts a central palm oil tree with green, feathery fronds and clusters of reddish-brown fruit. The trunk is brown with a textured, layered surface. Stuck into the side of the trunk is a small axe with a blue-and-red head and a light-colored wooden handle. Surrounding this central tree are numerous brown tree stumps, some with yellow rings on their flat tops, scattered across an off-white background with gray brushstrokes. 

Below the central tree is a red rectangular box containing the white word "INVESTIGASI." Underneath, large black text reads "HUTAN BINASA, SAWIT TAK ADA." Smaller black text below provides details about "MENARA GROUP," "BOVEN DIGOEL, PAPUA," and collaborations with "EARTHSIGHT," "MONGABAY," and "MALAYSIAKINI." Additional text at the top reads "SEJUMLAH CATATAN KSAD BARU" and "TIPU DAYA RENTENIR DIGITAL." A white box in the bottom-left corner contains a barcode and publication details including "26 NOVEMBER-2 DESEMBER 2018."
